issues.title: Vietnam sends condolences to Panama over serious earthquake
issues.title_en: Vietnam sends condolences to Panama over serious earthquake
issues.summary: General Secretary of the Communist Party of Vietnam Central Committee and President To Lam on October 11 sent a message of condolences to Panamanian President José Raúl Mulino Quintero following an earthquake on October 9 that injured many people and caused heavy damage. issues.title: Up to 12 casualties in attack on Saudi Arabia – including an Egyptian flight attendant
issues.title_en: Up to 12 casualties in attack on Saudi Arabia – including an Egyptian flight attendant
issues.summary: Saudi Arabia’s General Authority of Civil Aviation on Sunday announced that the toll from the attack targeting King Khalid International Airport in Riyadh had risen to 12 casualties and 309 injuries. The victims were of various nationalities, the authority noted, while assessments of material damage remain ongoing.
